rationale: Micah brings deep expertise in visual interfaces for complex systems (data visualization, ML tooling, WebXR) while Mufaddal has spent his career shipping mission-critical embedded software at scale (automotive, IoT, firmware delivery). At a Physical AI hackathon, Mufaddal's embedded and connectivity systems knowledge could ground Micah's visual/interface work in real hardware constraints, and Micah's design intuition could help surface insights from Mufaddal's low-level systems work—complementary skill sets for building tangible AI products.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Mufaddal Esmael — one specializes in making AI systems visually intuitive, the other in shipping embedded software that works reliably in the real world; could be a strong pairing for a physical AI build.
